verdict.rationale: JumpCloud publishes an API reference (docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml) describing GET endpoints for traversing the JumpCloud Graph, and a GitHub support repo offers API example scripts, indicating some API documentation and example tooling exists. However, there is no evidence of an interactive, in-browser 'try it out' style reference with runnable examples, and probes for common interactive-doc artifacts (openapi.json, swagger.json, llms.txt) returned 404s. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of interactive/try-it-now API explorer UI, runnable code snippets embedded in docs, and independent corroboration of an interactive reference experience.
